## Documentation

A statistical graph whose data must be loaded asynchronously.

The data can be loaded with the raw function [`LoadAsyncGraph`](../../raw/functions/stats-l.md#loadasyncgraph).

### Parameters

- **`token`** (`str`)
  The token to use for loading the data.
